Rahul Gandhi Sangrur Speech: Addressing an Insaaf Rally in Sangrur, Rahul Gandhi questioned Amit Shah’s three-year timeline to eradicate Punjab’s drug problem. The Congress leader claimed the government would not last another year and took a swipe at the Union Home Minister.
